Coram : K.S. RADHAKRISHNAN*, MADAN B. LOKUR
Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2000 - s. 7A rlw. r. 12 of Juvenile Justice Rules, 2007 - C Inquiry under - Nature, scope and ambit of - Claim of juvenility - Procedure to be followed - For determination of age - Held: Age determination inquiry is contemplated u/s. 7A rlw is an inquiry under the Act and to be conducted following the procedure u/r. 12 and D not following the procedure under Cr.P. C. - Age to be determined initially on the basis of the documents/certificates as indicated in r. 12(3)(a)(i)(ii) and (iii) - The question of obtaining medical opinion
Decision Date : 13-09-2012 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 1403/2012 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
